lines: Caught in a net for capturing animals, Sakura was groaning in frustration.

Hahaha! It's your fault for falling for it! The world of competition is harsh!ー
Right, Shikanosuke?!
Shikanosuke replied happily, laying his hand on the string of the trap.
In this training, we were allowed the use of two "supporters" each.
I had chosen Shikanosuke as one of my supporters and instructed him to stand by for an ambush.
As soon as Sakura had arrived, Shikanosuke had activated several traps at once and captured her in the net.
Fuma, don't forget your promise to treat me to something!
Of course! It's a small price to pay for the right to an allowance. I'll leave the rest to you!

The only thing left was to get to the goalー
but then a figure stood in my way.
Fuma-kun, I'm not impressed by such unchivalrous behavior.
Ugh, Rinko-senpai!! So Sakura asked you to help her...
Indeed. Because the students who know about Sakura's situation are basically only me and her.
And in the direction Rinko-senpai pointed was...
Really, Shikanosuke-chan, you can't do sneaky stuff like that!
Aieee!? Stop it, Hebiko, not the iiiiink!!
Ugh!? Hebiko!? So she's also Sakura's supporter!
I was able to see Hebiko send Shikanosuke running with her octopus ink and set Sakura free from the net.
Don't mention it~ Please do your best, young Sakura-sensei♪
C'mon, just call me Sakura! Alright, time to catch up!!
Having slipped free of the net, Sakura picked up the pace and came after me in hot pursuit.
And while Rinko-senpai blocked my path and held me back, Sakura would take the lead... Or so they seemed to be planning.
Heheh. Fuma-kun, looks like your little tricks are over.
Are you so sure about that...?
What? Don't tell me you're going to try to fight me at your strengthー

As if. I know my own strength well enoughー
Now!
Taking the powerful blow from above, even someone like Rinko-senpai sank to her knees.
Yes, Akiyama-san. That's how it is.
Another ambusher had been hiding in the top of a tree. It was Kise Hotaru-senpai, who had fought together with us during the Chaos Arena incident.
Contrary to her appearance, she was a heavy-hitting Taimanin, and you had to hand it to Rinko-senpai for being able to stand back up after taking one of her strikes.
Go ahead, Fuma-kun. With Akiyama-san as my opponent, I'll have my hands full holding her back!
Got it! I'm counting on you!!
I left Hotaru-senpai to deal with Rinko-senpai and hurried onwards.
(I can't let her have the allowance... absolutely not!!!)
And the two who were left behindー
I didn't think I'd have to fight against you in a place like this. It might be more fun than I expected.
I ask that you go easy on me.
The two of them smiled, glared at each other for a few moments, and then clashed furiously with their weapons.
Haah... haah... Good, only a bit further...
Muhuhu~ That's not going to happen, Fuma-kun!
I thought the trap had given me a bit of a lead, but she had caught up with me in a flash. And she wasn't even out of breath.
(Shit, the difference in our physical ability is hopeless... I shouldn't have skipped long-distance running lessons.)
(Nah, that wouldn't get me to that level. To her strength...)
What's more, Sakura hadn't even used her specialty yet, her Shadow Jutsu.
(I still can't afford to lose though!! If it comes to this there's only one last resort...)
I grabbed the "last resort" I had kept hidden inside my Taima-Suit.
Looks like I've already won. Nice! I'll see you later~!
Wait, Sakura! Can't you see this!?
What I had taken out of my pocket and held aloft wasー
The long-awaited game releasing today!! Goddess Hunter World!!
It was the first new installment of the hugely popular game series in three years. Sakura, who had been eagerly awaiting the release, couldn't help but stare with gleaming eyes.
Yeah, and it's the limited premium edition.
The one with Amaterasuko-chan unlocked at the start, who is designed by Hokkai Kagami-sensei, with a serial code for collaboration costumes included, and a gorgeous art book...
...and the soundtrack CD, and the limited equipment that you can only obtain with this edition... that one!?
You know a lot about it.
I-I mean, I've been visiting the official site every day... I really wanted to have it, but there was no way I could buy it on my allowance...
I see. So, do you wanna play it?
Good. And what do you see over there?
The box with the new game came out of my hand, made a beautiful arc in the air, and flew into the river.
Ahhhhh~!?! Fuma-kun, what are you doing!?!?
Sakura completely forgot about our competition and chased after the package that was being swept away.
I ran towards the goal like a cheetah, glancing back to see Sakura picking up the game.
And wait, this is just the box with nothing in it!?
Duh! Do you think I would endanger my precious limited premium edition?
You're stupid! You're a coward, Fuma-kun!!
Gooooal!! I made it! I won!!
I had outrun Sakura, while she had gone after the game, and made it to the finish line.
I did it...! I defended my right to get an allowance!!
Hahaha!! The cries of the loser are like music to my ears!! Mwahahahaha!!
You must be tired, both of you.
Tokiko! You were watching, right?! I won!
Yes, I was. As expected from you, Master.
That cowardly behavior of yours was beyond the pale.
You can say that agai-... huh?
Using any means necessary in order to win is, indeed, one possible correct answer.
However, you must not forget that we Taimanin have to act with a heart of justice because of the power we possess...
It seems to me that the measures you have taken this time might be a bit problematic, Master, especially if you consider that this training was to increase your "self-awareness as a Taimanin."
Something was starting to smell fishy.
Master, who deployed cowardly tactics, and Sakura-san, who fell behind to those tactics...
To both of you... I declare this a draw.
So you're saying... neither of us will receive an allowance...?
Sakura looked visibly crestfallen. Tokiko smiled and continued.
Both of you showed a lot of motivation.
So as an exception this time, I'll continue to give Master his allowance, but Sakura's share will be raised slightly.
We completely forgot about our fight from just moments ago and clasped hands in joy.
From now on, both of you will have to act with proper self-awareness as Taimanin.
That means... we can still only play games an hour per day?
But... this is the long-awaited, brand-new Goddess Hunter World...
If you can't live a disciplined life, then maybe I should keep your allowance after allー
Tokiko smiled as she watched Sakura panic and withdraw her appeal.
If you two become elite Taimanin, I won't be so strict on you. So please keep up with your training.
